notes: Pubs, bars and bottle shops: OpenStreetMap only. Queensland publishes no bulk licence list, so venue lines are thinner than in Sydney or Melbourne.

Grey areas: suburbs with fewer than 1,000 residents or fewer than 300 people per km² (parks, farmland, bush, airports, industrial land). The Census covers them, but they are left out so empty land doesn't count as much as busy suburbs. The grey areas on this map hold 141,233 people, 6.1% of the total.

explain.the-hi-vis-line:
What does "hi-vis" mean?

Hi-vis is Australian slang for the bright, high-visibility vests worn on building sites, roads, warehouses and delivery routes.

Here it means driving, machine and labouring jobs, compared with managers and professionals. It describes jobs, not people.
